critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every requests call to the backend host. This is convenient for admin-gated GETs but BREAKS cross-portal isolation tests — any test trying to assert that a non-admin token gets 401 must explicitly send 'X-Admin-Token: ""' to override the conftest setdefault. Consider scoping the auto-inject to opt-in fixtures rather than module-global monkeypatch.

Daily Report PDF is generated via render_record_pdf only in the admin email-record + backup-zip code paths. There is no GET /api/daily-reports/{id}/pdf endpoint despite multiple legacy tests (iter41, iter68, iter75) assuming one exists — those tests have been silently skipping for several iterations. Either add the endpoint or remove the dead tests.

Signature R2 migration verified working — sample sig: photo://masci-hub/photos/2026/05/daily_reports-{id}-prepared_by_signature/{hash}. 4/54 daily reports carry photo:// refs; 50 have no signature (which is expected — many DRs are auto-generated). No base64 data: URLs detected in any record's signature field — migration is clean.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter77_regression.py is a reusable session-scoped pytest suite covering all 7 streams. To run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter77_regression.py -v. Note that /app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token globally — pass headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} explicitly to test true cross-portal isolation. /api/daily-reports/{id}/pdf does NOT exist as a public endpoint; legacy tests that hit it have been silently skipping. Signature R2 migration is COMPLETE — every signature in production is photo:// format (verified across 54 daily reports). All five portals log in cleanly with documented creds. Frontend ForgedOps footer presence needs human eyeball check on every page — text is not in DOM body innerText on Hub or Cheatsheet (could be image-based, ARIA-hidden, or genuinely missing — needs main agent confirmation).
rca_of_the_issue: Two backend test 'failures' were test infrastructure artifacts, not real regressions: (1) conftest.py monkey-patches requests.api.request and requests.sessions.Session.request to auto-inject X-Admin-Token on every backend call — this caused cross-portal isolation tests to spuriously pass with admin auth even when only HR token was set. Fixed by explicitly passing X-Admin-Token: '' to override the setdefault. (2) Leadership login path was tested as /api/leadership/login but the actual route is /api/field-leadership/login. Fixed. Real cross-portal isolation verified clean via curl — HR token alone returns 401 on /api/admin/jobs with 'Admin or PM login required' message.
